observations: Photo 0 shows a front view of a printer with an HP logo on the front panel. The printer has a beige and black color scheme with a control panel on the right side.

Photo 1 shows a printed configuration page from the printer. The header clearly reads 'HP LaserJet P4015 Printers'. The page includes details like printer name, serial number, firmware version, memory, and paper tray options.
Photo 2 shows a front-left angled view of the same printer. A white label on the front reads 'HP LaserJet P4015x'. The printer has three paper trays visible at the bottom, labeled 1, 2, and 3.
All photos have a watermark 'GOLD TECHNOLOGIES POSTED ON JIJI'.

claims.claim: The printer is direct foreign used with everything intact
claims.evidence: Photos show the printer and a configuration page, but no proof of origin or completeness of accessories. No cables, power adapter, or manuals are visible.

Photo 0 shows visible smudges and minor discoloration on the beige front panel, and photo 2 shows slight wear on the top cover and around the control panel. These are not consistent with 'no scratch'.

Photo 1 shows a printed configuration page, which suggests the printer can print. However, no video or additional photos show the printer in operation, nor is there proof of toner, paper feed, or scanning (if applicable).

risks.risk: Printer may not be fully functional (e.g., toner issues, paper jams, or connectivity problems)
risks.proof: Video showing the printer printing a test page, scanning, and powering on with all functions working.

risks.risk: Missing accessories (power cord, USB cable, manuals, toner cartridge)
risks.proof: Photo showing all included accessories laid out next to the printer.

risks.risk: Hidden damage or wear not visible in photos (e.g., internal components, fuser unit, or drum)
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the interior, including the fuser, drum, and paper path.

proof_requests: Video of the printer printing a test page and powering on.
Photo showing all included accessories (power cord, USB cable, manuals, toner).
Close-up photos of the interior components (fuser, drum, paper path).
response.reason: The model is clearly identified as HP LaserJet P4015x from the configuration page and front label. However, the seller's claims about no scratches and working condition are contradicted or unverified by the photos. Hidden risks like missing accessories and internal damage cannot be ruled out without further proof. The item cannot be priced accurately without verification of functionality and completeness.
